description:
Lets connect and talk about you goals: https://calendly.com/realestatestephen/30min
Thinking about moving to Killeen, Texas — or wondering if it’s still the right place for your family long-term? In this video, I’m sharing the real reasons I left Killeen, Texas after living, working, and building my real estate career in the Fort Hood area.

This is not a Killeen-bashing video. Killeen can be a great fit for military families, first-time homebuyers, VA buyers, and people who want more house for less money in Central Texas. But for my family, our season of life changed. Childcare, neighborhood amenities, community, and proximity to Austin all became major factors in our decision to move.

I’ll break down why we left, what we were looking for, and why Killeen may still be the right answer for some buyers — especially if affordability, Fort Hood access, and long-term equity building matter to you.

Before you buy in Killeen, Harker Heights, Copperas Cove, Nolanville, or anywhere near Fort Hood, start with your “why.” The right city depends on your family, your lifestyle, your budget, and your 5–10 year plan.

Thinking about buying or selling in the greater Fort Hood area? Schedule a strategy call here:
realestatesteph.co

Stephen Harris is a Central Texas real estate broker helping home buyers and sellers make smarter decisions in the Killeen, Harker Heights, Copperas Cove, Pflugerville, and greater Fort Hood area.
